# COMPUTE-NODE

<!-- generated by scripts/docs/generate_system_docs.py; edit source manifests, schemas or detailed docs -->

Detailed sources: `docs/operations/compute-node.md` and
`docs/architecture/future-profiles.md`.

Heavy capabilities route through signed remote job packets only when a
compatible compute node, image digest, checkpoint interval and budget
receipt are available. Missing node, architecture mismatch, revoked image
or exhausted budget returns a typed WAIT/REJECT decision; SRF must not fall
back to an unbounded local Mac run.

Current state: `WAIT_COMPUTE_NODE`.
